title: Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - Post-Award Formalities - Bonds
subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: Following the formal execution of a construction contract and the receipt of the required Performance and Payment bonds from the winning vendor, what must the procurement officer do regarding the unsuccessful bidders?
options: Cash their bid bonds to fund the project contingency
Return or release their Bid Bonds/Securities promptly
Send them an invoice for administrative processing fees
Require them to serve as backup subcontractors
questions.explain: A Bid Bond is held to ensure the low bidder will sign the contract. Once the winner signs and provides performance bonds, the risk is mitigated, and all other bidders' bid bonds must be legally released/returned.
